messages:
nina: Heads-up we're launching a small billing update: prepaid pools + 7-day smoothing for large overages. Short summary below.

jacob: Summary: create a prepaid pool (charged at creation) that usage draws from first. If pool empties, usage falls back to metered billing or configured fallback. Smoothing averages big overage spikes across 7 days on invoices.

billing-bot: API: POST /billing/pools, GET /billing/pools/{id}/balance, POST /billing/pools/{id}/topup. Feature flag: billing.prepay_v1.

cs-lead: CS notes: free trial credits will not be consumed by pools by default. Refunds allowed within 30 days; small processing fee applies for tiny amounts. One-pager coming.

nina: Rollout: canary Friday 02:00 UTC -> global over 4h. Console banner + docs publish next Tuesday. Please review the launch doc. :thumbsup:
